questions.stem: A 55-year-old emaciated alcoholic male presents with a 2-day history of chest pain after forceful vomiting. He is taken to the OR for a thoracotomy after he is found to have an esophageal rupture. A jejunal feeding tube is placed and he is started on tube feeds on POD 1, when he develops confusion, shallow breathing, and pulmonary edema. What electrolyte abnormalities do you expect to see?
